text: “You must have a lawyer,” pursued my guardian. “We must engage a good one for you.” “I ask your pardon, sir,” said Mr. George with a step backward. “I am equally obliged. But I must decidedly beg to be excused from anything of that sort.” “You won’t have a lawyer?” “No, sir.” Mr. George shook his head in the most emphatic manner. “I thank you all the same, sir, but—no lawyer!” “Why not?” “I don’t take kindly to the breed,” said Mr. George.
